<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Sibyl Labs Docs · agentic memory infrastructure</title>
  <meta name="description" content="Documentation for Sibyl Memory: local-first, file-based agentic memory. SQLite, zero embeddings, #2 on LongMemEval. Install, concepts, CLI, integrations, and benchmarks.">
  <link rel="canonical" href="https://docs.sibyllabs.org/">
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#f5f1e6">
  <meta property="og:title" content="Sibyl Labs Docs · agentic memory infrastructure">
  <meta property="og:description" content="Local-first, file-based agentic memory. SQLite, zero embeddings, #2 on LongMemEval.">
  <meta property="og:type" content="website">
  <meta property="og:url" content="https://docs.sibyllabs.org/">
  <link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="/_static/sibyl-labs-logo.png">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link rel="preload" as="font" type="font/woff2" href="/_static/fonts/SweetSansPro-Medium.woff2" crossorigin>
  <link rel="preload" as="font" type="font/woff2" href="/_static/fonts/SweetSansPro-Regular.woff2" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,300..700&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/_static/style.css?v=20260629">
  <style>
    /* === BRAND FONTS (SweetSansPro display + IBM Plex Mono).
       Font files ship on the docs deploy at /_static/fonts/ (served today);
       redeclared inline so the display font is guaranteed on this page even if
       style.css cache-busts. Safe fallback stack degrades gracefully. === */
    @font-face {
      font-family: 'Sweet Sans Pro';
      src: url('/_static/fonts/SweetSansPro-Regular.woff2') format('woff2');
      font-weight: 400; font-style: normal; font-display: swap;
    }
    @font-face {
      font-family: 'Sweet Sans Pro';
      src: url('/_static/fonts/SweetSansPro-Medium.woff2') format('woff2');
      font-weight: 500; font-style: normal; font-display: swap;
    }
    @font-face {
      font-family: 'Sweet Sans Pro';
      src: url('/_static/fonts/SweetSansPro-Bold.woff2') format('woff2');
      font-weight: 700; font-style: normal; font-display: swap;
    }
    @font-face {
      font-family: 'Sweet Sans Pro';
      src: url('/_static/fonts/SweetSansPro-Heavy.woff2') format('woff2');
      font-weight: 900; font-style: normal; font-display: swap;
    }

    /* === BRAND TOKENS — reconciled to sibyllabs.org (redraft-d) exactly.
       Overrides the shared style.css :root so docs shares the identical
       palette + type + spacing + radii + nav-inverse system. === */
    :root {
      /* light-mode lab palette */
      --paper:        #f5f1e6;
      --paper-deep:   #ede6d3;
      --card:         #fdfbf5;
      --ink:          #15110a;
      --ink-soft:     #2c271d;
      --ink-mute:     #6a6356;
      --ink-faint:    #98917f;
      --rule:         #d8d0bb;
      --rule-strong:  #b8ae93;
      --accent:       #8a6a2a;
      --accent-warm:  #a08438;
      --accent-faint: rgba(138,106,42,0.10);
      --accent-line:  rgba(138,106,42,0.30);
      --jade:         #2d6e6a;
      --jade-faint:   rgba(45,110,106,0.08);
      --pulse:        #1d8a82;
      --cyan:         #0a726a;
      --cyan-faint:   rgba(10,114,106,0.10);
      --cyan-line:    rgba(10,114,106,0.30);

      --font-display: 'Sweet Sans Pro', 'Fraunces', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
      --font-mono:    'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;
      --ease:         cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1);
      --e-out:        cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1);

      --grid-max:     1180px;
      --gutter:       clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 4rem);

      /* spacing scale (4/8 grid) */
      --space-1: 0.25rem; --space-2: 0.5rem; --space-3: 0.75rem;
      --space-4: 1rem;    --space-5: 1.5rem; --space-6: 2rem;
      --space-7: 3rem;    --space-8: 4rem;   --space-9: 6rem;

      /* type scale */
      --fs-display-1: clamp(2.25rem, 5.2vw, 4.25rem);
      --fs-display-2: clamp(1.65rem, 3.6vw, 2.6rem);
      --fs-display-3: clamp(1.2rem, 1.9vw, 1.5rem);
      --fs-lead:      clamp(1rem, 1.4vw, 1.2rem);
      --fs-body:      0.9375rem;
      --fs-mono-xs:   0.625rem;
      --fs-mono-sm:   0.75rem;
      --fs-mono-md:   0.8125rem;
      --fs-mono-lg:   0.875rem;

      /* radii */
      --radius-pill:  999px;
      --radius-card:  8px;
      --radius-chip:  3px;
      --radius-sm:    4px;

      --shadow-sm: 0 2px 8px rgba(26, 24, 20, 0.04);
      --shadow-md: 0 4px 24px rgba(26, 24, 20, 0.06);
      --shadow-lg: 0 12px 48px rgba(26, 24, 20, 0.08), 0 2px 8px rgba(26, 24, 20, 0.04);

      /* NAV-INVERSE tokens: header always contrasts the body */
      --nav-bg:        #16120b;
      --nav-surface:   #221b10;
      --nav-ink:       #f4efe2;
      --nav-ink-mute:  #b3a98d;
      --nav-rule:      rgba(244,239,226,0.12);
      --nav-accent:    #cda85f;
      --nav-cta-bg:    #a88c46;
      --nav-cta-ink:   #16120b;
      --nav-cta-hover: #c6a458;
    }

    /* === DARK MODE — warm on-brand palette (rule 46). Body tokens FLIP;
       nav tokens flip OPPOSITE to a creme header. === */
    html.dark {
      --paper:        #100d07;
      --paper-deep:   #1a150c;
      --card:         #201a10;
      --ink:          #f2ede0;
      --ink-soft:     #d5cdba;
      --ink-mute:     #9a927e;
      --ink-faint:    #6e6656;
      --rule:         #2c2618;
      --rule-strong:  #403827;
      --accent:       #b08f45;
      --accent-warm:  #c6a458;
      --accent-faint: rgba(176,143,69,0.14);
      --accent-line:  rgba(176,143,69,0.30);
      --cyan:         #36d8ca;
      --cyan-faint:   rgba(54,216,202,0.12);
      --cyan-line:    rgba(54,216,202,0.30);
      --jade:         #36d8ca;
      --jade-faint:   rgba(54,216,202,0.12);
      --pulse:        #36d8ca;
      --shadow-sm:    0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
      --shadow-md:    0 6px 26px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
      --shadow-lg:    0 16px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.55);

      /* nav flips to LIGHT (creme) header when the body is dark */
      --nav-bg:        #f5f1e6;
      --nav-surface:   #ede6d3;
      --nav-ink:       #16120b;
      --nav-ink-mute:  #6a6356;
      --nav-rule:      rgba(21,17,10,0.12);
      --nav-accent:    #6f5316;
      --nav-cta-bg:    #16120b;
      --nav-cta-ink:   #f5f1e6;
      --nav-cta-hover: #2c271d;
    }

    /* dark-mode page grounds: flip the body + shared style.css chrome that
       hard-codes creme. Body background/text come from the tokens above; these
       cover surfaces style.css paints with literal light values. */
    html.dark body { background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); }

    /* === NAV (from redraft-d — token-driven inverse header) === */
    .nav {
      position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 100;
      padding: var(--space-4) max(var(--gutter), env(safe-area-inset-left)) var(--space-4) max(var(--gutter), env(safe-area-inset-right));
      background: var(--nav-bg);
      backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(180%);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(180%);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--nav-rule);
      transition: background-color .25s ease, color .25s ease, border-color .25s ease;
    }
    @media (max-width: 720px), (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .nav { backdrop-filter: none; -webkit-backdrop-filter: none; background: var(--nav-bg); }
    }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .nav, .nav-drawer, .nav-cta-agent, .nav-social-icon, .nav-icon-link,
      .nav-theme-toggle, .nav-hamburger, .nav-drawer-close, .nav-drawer-links a,
      .nav-drawer-socials a, .drawer-theme-toggle { transition: none !important; }
    }
    .nav-inner {
      max-width: var(--grid-max); margin: 0 auto;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--space-4);
    }
    .wordmark {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.65rem;
      font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 600; font-size: var(--fs-mono-lg);
      color: var(--nav-ink); letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase;
      flex-shrink: 0; transition: color .25s ease; text-decoration: none; border: none;
    }
    .wordmark:hover { color: var(--nav-ink); }
    .wordmark .brand-name { color: var(--nav-ink); display: inline-block; }
    .wordmark .brand-mark {
      width: 0; height: 28px; flex-shrink: 0; transition: width 0.3s var(--ease);
    }
    /* docs serves the light (creme) mark at /_static/sibyl-icon-light.png and the
       dark mark at /_static/sibyl-labs-logo.png — creme mark on the dark header, dark mark on the creme header. */
    .wordmark .brand-mark.has-logo {
      width: 32px;
      background-image: url("/_static/sibyl-icon-light.png");
      background-size: contain; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-position: center;
    }
    html.dark .wordmark .brand-mark.has-logo {
      background-image: url("/_static/sibyl-labs-logo.png");
    }

    /* center: social icons */
    .nav-socials { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-3); }
    .nav-social-icon {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      width: 32px; height: 32px; color: var(--nav-ink-mute);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill); border: none;
      transition: color 0.2s var(--ease), background 0.2s var(--ease);
    }
    .nav-social-icon:hover { color: var(--nav-accent); background: var(--nav-rule); }
    .nav-social-icon svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: currentColor; }

    /* right: page links + Meet the Agent CTA */
    .nav-links { display: flex; gap: var(--space-3); align-items: center; }
    .nav-icon-link {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.4rem;
      width: 34px; height: 34px; color: var(--nav-ink-mute);
      border: 1px solid var(--nav-rule); border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      transition: color 0.2s var(--ease), border-color 0.2s var(--ease), background 0.2s var(--ease);
      position: relative; background: transparent; text-decoration: none;
    }
    .nav-icon-link:hover { color: var(--nav-accent); border-color: var(--nav-accent); background: var(--nav-rule); }
    .nav-icon-link svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
    .nav-brain { width: 40px; height: 40px; border: none; color: var(--nav-accent); }
    .nav-brain svg { width: 26px; height: 26px; stroke-width: 1.9; }
    .nav-brain:hover { background: none; color: var(--nav-ink); transform: scale(1.08); }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .nav-brain:hover { transform: none; } }
    .nav-icon-link::after {
      content: attr(data-tooltip); position: absolute; top: calc(100% + 8px); left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-4px);
      font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--fs-mono-xs); letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--nav-bg); background: var(--nav-ink);
      padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: var(--radius-chip); white-space: nowrap;
      opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 0.15s var(--ease), transform 0.15s var(--ease);
    }
    .nav-icon-link:hover::after { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); }

    /* theme toggle (lightbulb) */
    .nav-theme-toggle { cursor: pointer; background: transparent; font: inherit; }
    .nav-theme-toggle svg { transition: opacity 0.2s var(--ease); }
    .nav-theme-toggle .bulb-rays { opacity: 1; transition: opacity 0.2s var(--ease); }
    html.dark .nav-theme-toggle .bulb-rays { opacity: 0; }
    .nav-theme-toggle .bulb-fill { opacity: 0.9; transition: opacity 0.2s var(--ease); }
    html.dark .nav-theme-toggle .bulb-fill { opacity: 0.35; }
    @media (pointer: coarse) { .nav-theme-toggle { width: 44px; height: 44px; } }

    /* Meet the Agent CTA */
    .nav-cta-agent {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;
      padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-5); min-height: 36px;
      font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--fs-mono-xs); font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--nav-cta-ink);
      border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); background: var(--nav-cta-bg);
      transition: transform 0.22s var(--ease), box-shadow 0.22s var(--ease), background-color 0.22s ease, color 0.22s ease;
      text-decoration: none;
    }
    .nav-cta-agent:hover {
      color: var(--nav-cta-ink); background: var(--nav-cta-hover); transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28), 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
    }
    @media (pointer: coarse) { .nav-cta-agent { min-height: 44px; } }

    /* mobile: hide desktop links, show hamburger */
    @media (max-width: 720px) {
      .nav-socials { display: none; }
      .nav-links { display: none; }
      .nav-hamburger { display: flex; }
    }
    @media (min-width: 721px) {
      .nav-hamburger { display: none; }
      .nav-inner { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; align-items: center; }
      .nav-inner > .wordmark   { justify-self: start; }
      .nav-inner > .nav-socials { justify-self: center; }
      .nav-inner > .nav-links  { justify-self: end; }
    }
    .nav-hamburger {
      width: 38px; height: 38px; border: 1px solid var(--nav-rule);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill); background: var(--nav-surface); color: var(--nav-ink);
      cursor: pointer; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0;
      transition: color 0.22s var(--ease), border-color 0.22s var(--ease), background-color 0.22s ease;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .nav-hamburger:hover, .nav-hamburger:focus-visible { border-color: var(--nav-accent); color: var(--nav-accent); outline: none; }
    .nav-hamburger svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; stroke: currentColor; fill: none; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; }

    /* mobile drawer */
    .nav-drawer-overlay {
      position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(21, 17, 10, 0.4); z-index: 199;
      opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 0.25s var(--ease);
    }
    .nav-drawer-overlay.open { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }
    .nav-drawer {
      position: fixed; top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; width: min(320px, 85vw);
      background: var(--nav-bg); border-left: 1px solid var(--nav-rule); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      z-index: 200; transform: translateX(100%);
      transition: transform 0.3s var(--ease), background-color .25s ease, color .25s ease;
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: var(--space-6) var(--space-5);
    }
    .nav-drawer.open { transform: translateX(0); }
    .nav-drawer-close {
      align-self: flex-end; width: 36px; height: 36px; border: 1px solid var(--nav-rule);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill); background: transparent; color: var(--nav-ink-mute);
      cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-6); transition: color 0.2s var(--ease), border-color 0.2s var(--ease);
    }
    .nav-drawer-close:hover { border-color: var(--nav-accent); color: var(--nav-accent); }
    .nav-drawer-close svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; stroke: currentColor; fill: none; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; }
    .nav-drawer-links { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
    .nav-drawer-links a {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-3);
      padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-4); min-height: 48px;
      font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm); letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--nav-ink); border-radius: var(--radius-chip);
      text-decoration: none; border: none;
      transition: background 0.15s var(--ease), color 0.15s var(--ease);
    }
    .nav-drawer-links a:hover { background: var(--nav-rule); color: var(--nav-accent); }
    .nav-drawer-links .drawer-cta { color: var(--nav-accent); font-weight: 600; }
    .nav-drawer-links .drawer-sep { height: 1px; background: var(--nav-rule); margin: var(--space-3) 0; list-style: none; }
    .nav-drawer-socials {
      display: flex; gap: var(--space-3); margin-top: auto; padding-top: var(--space-6);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--nav-rule);
    }
    .nav-drawer-socials a {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      width: 40px; height: 40px; color: var(--nav-ink-mute);
      border: 1px solid var(--nav-rule); border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      transition: color 0.2s var(--ease), border-color 0.2s var(--ease);
    }
    .nav-drawer-socials a:hover { color: var(--nav-accent); border-color: var(--nav-accent); }
    .nav-drawer-socials svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: currentColor; }
    .drawer-theme-toggle {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-3); width: 100%;
      padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-4); min-height: 48px;
      font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm); letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--nav-ink); background: transparent; border: none;
      border-radius: var(--radius-chip); cursor: pointer;
      transition: background 0.15s var(--ease), color 0.15s var(--ease);
    }
    .drawer-theme-toggle:hover { background: var(--nav-rule); color: var(--nav-accent); }
    .drawer-theme-toggle svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .drawer-theme-toggle .bulb-rays { opacity: 1; }
    html.dark .drawer-theme-toggle .bulb-rays { opacity: 0; }
    .drawer-theme-toggle .label-dark { display: inline; }
    .drawer-theme-toggle .label-light { display: none; }
    html.dark .drawer-theme-toggle .label-dark { display: none; }
    html.dark .drawer-theme-toggle .label-light { display: inline; }

    /* push the docs body clear of the fixed nav */
    body { padding-top: 4.25rem; }

    /* === FOOTER (from redraft-d) === */
    .footer {
      padding:
        clamp(3rem, 7vh, 5rem)
        max(var(--gutter), env(safe-area-inset-right))
        max(clamp(2rem, 5vh, 3rem), env(safe-area-inset-bottom))
        max(var(--gutter), env(safe-area-inset-left));
      border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); background: var(--paper-deep);
      position: relative; z-index: 1;
    }
    .footer-inner {
      max-width: var(--grid-max); margin: 0 auto; display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4rem); align-items: start;
    }
    @media (min-width: 768px) { .footer-inner { grid-template-columns: 1.5fr 1fr; } }
    .footer-brand { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-3); max-width: 34rem; }
    .footer-logo { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; text-decoration: none; border: none; }
    .footer-mark {
      width: 30px; height: 30px; flex-shrink: 0;
      background: url("/_static/sibyl-labs-logo.png") center / contain no-repeat; /* dark mark on the creme footer */
    }
    html.dark .footer-mark { background-image: url("/_static/sibyl-icon-light.png"); } /* creme mark on the dark footer */
    .footer-wordmark {
      font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 600; font-size: var(--fs-mono-lg);
      letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink);
    }
    .footer-tagline {
      font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm); color: var(--ink-mute);
      letter-spacing: 0.02em; line-height: 1.7; margin: 0;
    }
    .footer-socials { display: flex; gap: var(--space-3); margin-top: var(--space-2); }
    .footer-socials a {
      width: 40px; height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--ink-mute);
      transition: color .2s var(--ease), border-color .2s var(--ease), transform .2s var(--ease);
    }
    .footer-socials a:hover { color: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .footer-socials svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: currentColor; }
    .footer-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(8rem, 1fr)); gap: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 2.75rem); }
    @media (min-width: 768px) { .footer-nav { justify-self: end; } }
    .footer-col { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
    .footer-col-head {
      font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--fs-mono-xs); letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--ink-faint); margin-bottom: var(--space-2);
    }
    .footer-col a {
      font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm); color: var(--ink-mute);
      letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-decoration: none; padding: 0.4rem 0; min-height: 40px;
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; transition: color .2s var(--ease); border: none;
    }
    .footer-col a:hover { color: var(--accent); }
    .footer-bar {
      max-width: var(--grid-max); margin: clamp(2.5rem, 5vh, 3.5rem) auto 0; padding-top: var(--space-4);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);

    <div class="section-eyebrow">The thesis</div>
    <h2 class="section-title">Three pillars of agentic infrastructure</h2>
    <p class="section-lede">An agent you can leave running rests on three things. A verifiable identity. A memory that compounds. Compliance enforced by architecture. Get those right and autonomy stops being a risk you manage. It becomes the work you ship.</p>
    <div class="pillars">
      <div class="pillar" style="--pillar:#0a726a">
        <div class="p-num">01</div>
        <h3>Identity</h3>
        <p>A company will not hand real work to an anonymous process. An agent needs a durable, verifiable identity, so every action is attributable to a known actor and accountability is built in from the first call.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pillar" style="--pillar:#8a6a2a">
        <div class="p-num">02</div>
        <h3>Memory</h3>
        <p>An agent that forgets between sessions starts from zero every time, and a human pays the difference. Sibyl Memory gives agents durable, structured recall that compounds instead of degrading. The proven core: #2 on LongMemEval, file-based, zero embeddings.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pillar" style="--pillar:#5a3fd4">
        <div class="p-num">03</div>
        <h3>Compliance</h3>
        <p>Autonomy without boundaries is a liability, not a feature. Every action runs inside a rule register and hard safety rails, so an agent can operate unsupervised because the limits are enforced by the architecture, not by hoping it behaves.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="pillar-payoff">
      Together they do one thing: they give back the hours. The hours spent re-explaining context, re-checking output, and supervising every step. Strong architecture is what lets you trust an agent enough to step away. <b>That trust is the efficiency.</b>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="section" id="setup">
    <div class="section-eyebrow">Install & setup</div>
    <h2 class="section-title">Setup</h2>
    <p class="doc-lead">Three steps, about two minutes. You install it, sign in, and connect it to your AI.</p>

    <div class="doc-steps">
      <div class="doc-card">
        <div class="doc-kicker">Step 1</div>
        <h3>Install it</h3>
        <p>Pick either one. Both install everything you need in one go.</p>
        <div class="doc-options">
          <div>
            <span class="doc-option-label">Option A, with pip</span>
            <div class="doc-code"><pre><code>pip install 'sibyl-memory-cli[mcp]'</code></pre></div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span class="doc-option-label">Option B, one-line installer</span>
            <div class="doc-code"><pre><code>curl -fsSL https://sibyllabs.org/install | sh</code></pre></div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <p class="doc-note">Both pull in the full toolkit. If you see an "externally managed environment" error, jump to "If something did not work" at the bottom for the one-time fix.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="doc-card">
        <div class="doc-kicker">Step 2</div>
        <h3>Sign in</h3>
        <p>Run this. It opens a sign-in page in your browser.</p>
        <div class="doc-code"><pre><code>sibyl init</code></pre></div>
        <p>Sign in there with a wallet, or with your email and a code. The terminal picks it up on its own. The free plan gives you the full memory system at no cost, no card needed.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="doc-card">
        <div class="doc-kicker">Step 3</div>
        <h3>Connect it to your AI</h3>
        <p>This finds your AI app and connects Sibyl to it for you. No settings to edit.</p>
        <div class="doc-code"><pre><code>sibyl setup</code></pre></div>
        <p>Then restart your AI app. That is it, Sibyl is connected.</p>
        <p class="doc-note">It connects automatically to Claude Code, Codex, and Hermes. If you use a different app, <code>sibyl setup</code> wires the ones it recognizes; for anything else, add Sibyl in your app's own memory or connections settings. Either way your AI gains three new abilities: it can save, recall, and search what it remembers.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="doc-card">
        <div class="doc-kicker">Step 4</div>
        <h3>Test it works</h3>
        <p>Open your AI and tell it something worth remembering, like: "remember that I like short, direct answers." Close it, open it again later, and ask: "how do I like my answers?" It will know. That is the whole thing, your AI remembers now.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="doc-card">
        <h3>If something did not work</h3>
        <p>The steps above work for almost everyone. If the install showed an "externally managed environment" error, your system wants a sandbox first. These two lines make one and install Sibyl inside it:</p>
        <div class="doc-code"><pre><code>python3 -m venv ~/.sibyl-memory/venv && source ~/.sibyl-memory/venv/bin/activate
pip install 'sibyl-memory-cli[mcp]'</code></pre></div>
        <p>Then carry on from Step 2 (<code>sibyl init</code>).</p>
        <p class="doc-note">Connected nothing in Step 3? Make sure your AI app was open, then run <code>sibyl setup</code> again.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

    <div class="section-eyebrow">Keep it healthy</div>
    <h2 class="section-title">Management & maintenance</h2>
    <p class="doc-lead">Once Sibyl is installed, here is how to keep it healthy, up to date, and running lean. You will not reach for most of these day to day, they are here when you want them.</p>

    <div class="doc-subeyebrow">Everyday commands</div>
    <div class="doc-grid">
      <div class="doc-card">
        <h4>Check it is working</h4>
        <p class="doc-note">See your account, memory size, and plan:</p>
        <div class="doc-code"><pre><code>sibyl status</code></pre></div>
        <p class="doc-note">Run a quick self-check of the memory engine:</p>
        <div class="doc-code"><pre><code>sibyl health</code></pre></div>
      </div>

      <div class="doc-card">
        <h4>Keep it up to date</h4>
        <p class="doc-note">The plugin improves often. See if you are behind, then update in place:</p>
        <div class="doc-code"><pre><code>sibyl update</code></pre></div>
        <div class="doc-code"><pre><code>sibyl update --apply</code></pre></div>
        <p class="doc-note">If you connected Claude Code or Codex, also refresh the connector:</p>
        <div class="doc-code"><pre><code>pip install -U sibyl-memory-mcp</code></pre></div>
      </div>

      <div class="doc-card">
        <h4>Manage your devices</h4>
        <p class="doc-note">See and sign out the devices on your account:</p>
        <div class="doc-code"><pre><code>sibyl devices</code></pre></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="doc-subeyebrow">Best practices</div>
    <h3 class="section-title" style="font-size:clamp(1.35rem,2.6vw,1.8rem);margin-bottom:0.7rem;">Best practices: keep your context small.</h3>
    <p class="doc-lead">Sibyl works best when your AI keeps a small, sharp context and lets memory hold the rest. A lean context is faster, cheaper, and more accurate. Two habits keep it that way.</p>

    <div class="doc-bp-grid">
      <div class="doc-card">
        <h4>Move your context into memory</h4>
        <p>If your project keeps notes in files like <code>CLAUDE.md</code> or <code>AGENTS.md</code>, move them into memory once. Sibyl backs up every file first, checks the copies, then hands the transfer to your own AI to read on your machine. Sibyl Labs never sees your files.</p>
        <div class="doc-code"><pre><code>sibyl migrate</code></pre></div>
        <p class="doc-note">Run it from the project you want to bring over. Trimming the old files is the last step, it is optional, and only after you confirm.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="doc-card">
        <h4>Save at the end of a session</h4>
        <p>sibyl-save is a small companion skill that commits a whole session into memory in one step, so your progress carries to the next session and your working context stays clean. Install it once, then run it after a large session or at the end of any session.</p>
        <div class="doc-code-caption">Claude Code</div>
        <div class="doc-code"><pre><code>git clone https://github.com/Sibyl-Labs/sibyl-save
mkdir -p .claude/skills/sibyl-save && cp sibyl-save/SKILL.md .claude/skills/sibyl-save/</code></pre></div>
        <p class="doc-note">Then run <code>/sibyl-save setup</code> once, and <code>/sibyl-save</code> whenever you want to save. It works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Hermes.</p>
        <a href="https://github.com/Sibyl-Labs/sibyl-save" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="doc-link">sibyl-save on GitHub →</a>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="doc-upsell">
      <span class="doc-upsell-pill">On paid plans</span>
      <h4>Let it keep itself lean</h4>
      <p>On the free plan you keep memory tidy yourself with the two habits above. Paid plans are adding automatic debloat: it prunes and compacts your memory for you, so it stays lean and fast without you thinking about it.</p>

<script>
/* Living memory-graph hero background (dark face). Nodes = memory; edges =
   relations; teal/gold pulses = recall/write events traveling the graph.
   Bespoke, brand-palette, pointer-interactive. Respects reduced-motion. */
(function () {
  var canvas = document.getElementById('hero-canvas');
  if (!canvas || !canvas.getContext) return;
  var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  var hero = canvas.closest('.hero') || canvas.parentElement;
  var reduce = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  var W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1, nodes = [], pulses = [], raf = 0;
  var pointer = { x: -1, y: -1, on: false };
  var LINK = 138;

  function resize() {
    var r = hero.getBoundingClientRect();
    W = Math.max(1, r.width); H = Math.max(1, r.height);
    DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    canvas.width = Math.round(W * DPR); canvas.height = Math.round(H * DPR);
    ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
  }
  function seed() {
    var n = Math.max(24, Math.min(58, Math.round(W * H / 13000)));
    nodes = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      nodes.push({
        x: Math.random() * W, y: Math.random() * H,
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.10, vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.10,
        r: 1.0 + Math.random() * 1.9,
        accent: Math.random() < 0.18
      });
    }
    pulses = [];
  }
  function frame() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    var i, j;
    for (i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
      var p = nodes[i];
      p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy;
      if (p.x < -24) p.x = W + 24; else if (p.x > W + 24) p.x = -24;
      if (p.y < -24) p.y = H + 24; else if (p.y > H + 24) p.y = -24;
    }
    for (i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
      var a = nodes[i];
      for (j = i + 1; j < nodes.length; j++) {
        var b = nodes[j];
        var dx = a.x - b.x, dy = a.y - b.y, d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
        if (d2 < LINK * LINK) {
          var d = Math.sqrt(d2);
          var al = (1 - d / LINK) * 0.22;
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(206,226,221,' + al.toFixed(3) + ')';
          ctx.lineWidth = 0.6;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(a.x, a.y); ctx.lineTo(b.x, b.y); ctx.stroke();
          if (!reduce && Math.random() < 0.00016 && pulses.length < 12) {
            pulses.push({ a: a, b: b, t: 0, sp: 0.006 + Math.random() * 0.009, c: Math.random() < 0.5 });
          }
        }
      }
    }
    if (pointer.on) {
      for (i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
        var nn = nodes[i];
        var pdx = nn.x - pointer.x, pdy = nn.y - pointer.y, pd2 = pdx * pdx + pdy * pdy;
        if (pd2 < 150 * 150) {
          var pa = (1 - Math.sqrt(pd2) / 150) * 0.34;
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(54,216,202,' + pa.toFixed(3) + ')';
          ctx.lineWidth = 0.7;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(nn.x, nn.y); ctx.lineTo(pointer.x, pointer.y); ctx.stroke();
        }
      }
    }
    for (i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
      var c = nodes[i];
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, c.r, 0, 6.2832);
      ctx.fillStyle = c.accent ? 'rgba(201,168,78,0.62)' : 'rgba(232,240,237,0.34)';
      ctx.fill();
    }
    for (var k = pulses.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) {
      var pl = pulses[k]; pl.t += pl.sp;
      if (pl.t >= 1) { pulses.splice(k, 1); continue; }
      var x = pl.a.x + (pl.b.x - pl.a.x) * pl.t, y = pl.a.y + (pl.b.y - pl.a.y) * pl.t;
      var fade = Math.sin(pl.t * Math.PI);
      var rgb = pl.c ? '54,216,202' : '201,168,78'; /* teal | gold */
      var g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, 8);
      g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.6 * fade).toFixed(3) + ')');
      g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, 8, 0, 6.2832); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.95 * fade).toFixed(3) + ')';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, 1.6, 0, 6.2832); ctx.fill();
    }
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  function start() { stop(); if (reduce) { frame(); cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = 0; return; } raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame); }
  function stop() { if (raf) { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = 0; } }

  if (hero) {
    hero.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) {
      var r = hero.getBoundingClientRect();
      pointer.x = e.clientX - r.left; pointer.y = e.clientY - r.top; pointer.on = true;
    });
    hero.addEventListener('pointerleave', function () { pointer.on = false; });
  }
  var rt = 0;
  window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
    clearTimeout(rt); rt = setTimeout(function () { resize(); seed(); if (reduce) frame(); }, 180);
  });
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () {
    if (document.hidden) stop(); else if (!reduce) start();
  });

  resize(); seed(); start();
})();
</script>
<script>
/* Mobile drawer: open/close the nav drawer, lock scroll, close on link/overlay/Escape. */
(function() {
  var hamburger = document.getElementById('nav-hamburger');
  var drawer = document.getElementById('nav-drawer');
  var overlay = document.getElementById('nav-drawer-overlay');
  var closeBtn = document.getElementById('nav-drawer-close');
  if (!hamburger || !drawer) return;
  var scrollPos = 0;

  function openDrawer() {
    scrollPos = window.pageYOffset;
    drawer.classList.add('open');
    if (overlay) overlay.classList.add('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    document.body.style.position = 'fixed';
    document.body.style.top = '-' + scrollPos + 'px';
    document.body.style.width = '100%';
  }
  function closeDrawer() {
    drawer.classList.remove('open');
    if (overlay) overlay.classList.remove('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
    document.body.style.position = '';
    document.body.style.top = '';
    document.body.style.width = '';
    window.scrollTo(0, scrollPos);
  }

  hamburger.addEventListener('click', openDrawer);
  if (closeBtn) closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
  if (overlay) overlay.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
  drawer.addEventListener('click', function(e) { if (e.target.closest('a')) closeDrawer(); });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && drawer.classList.contains('open')) { closeDrawer(); hamburger.focus(); }
  });
})();
</script>
<script>
/* Theme toggle (lightbulb): flip html.dark, persist to localStorage, sync ARIA + theme-color.
   Reflects the theme the no-flash head script already applied on load. */
(function () {
  var root = document.documentElement;
  var toggles = [document.getElementById('theme-toggle'), document.getElementById('theme-toggle-drawer')].filter(Boolean);
  if (!toggles.length) return;
  var themeMeta = document.querySelector('meta[name="theme-color"]');

  function syncState() {
    var isDark = root.classList.contains('dark');
    toggles.forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', isDark ? 'true' : 'false');
      btn.setAttribute('aria-label', isDark ? 'Switch to light mode' : 'Switch to dark mode');
    });
    if (themeMeta) themeMeta.setAttribute('content', isDark ? '#100d07' : '#f5f1e6');
  }
  function toggleTheme() {
    var isDark = root.classList.toggle('dark');
    try { localStorage.setItem('sibyl-theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light'); } catch (e) {}
    syncState();
  }
  toggles.forEach(function (btn) { btn.addEventListener('click', toggleTheme); });
  syncState();
})();
</script>
